findings.problem: Saying 'with an added accent' could make a learner think historia has a written accent mark, but it has none.
findings.fix: trick: HISTORIA is just HISTORY with the Y swapped for an -IA ending, like many Spanish feminine nouns.

back.es: history (the past; the study of the past); also story
back.example: I love the history of Mexico.

note: The bare prompt "history" needs no hint, because the "story" card's hint already keeps the two meanings apart.
